## Où j'en suis
Prepared the Postgres 17 blue/green upgrade on the analytics RDS, staging first, on branch noa/rds-pg17. Parameter group family is now derived from the engine major version with create_before_destroy, blue/green enabled on staging (16.4 → 17.2), and prod is prepared but disabled behind `pg17_enabled = false` (plan shows no changes). AWS provider pinned to ~> 5.82.0 after v6 broke the plan; tflint is clean. Staging plan: 1 to add, 1 to change. Nothing applied — plan only, per instruction. Draft PR kestrel-analytics/infra#57 is open with pg_partman and dbt lock noted in the description.

- [en-cours] Staging upgrade ready to apply, but blocked on pg_partman 4.7.4 → 5.1.0 upgrade first (ALTER EXTENSION on 16.4, then verify run_maintenance_proc() on events_raw / events_daily)
- [prochaine-étape] Upgrade pg_partman to 5.x on staging (explicitly deferred, nothing run against the DB)
- [prochaine-étape] Apply staging blue/green after pg_partman is fixed
- [prochaine-étape] Pick production cutover window after Maya's sign-off
- [essai-raté] AWS provider v6 (from init -upgrade with >= 5.60.0) caused 37 unrelated changes (S3 ACL, aws_eip.vpc); reverted to pin ~> 5.82.0 (source: t04)
- [essai-raté] Proposed cutover Sat 28 Nov 02:00 UTC with apply_immediately = true; rejected — 02:00 falls inside the dbt lock, apply_immediately reverted to false (source: t14)
- [question] Production window: candidates Sat/Sun 04:00–06:00 UTC, pending Maya's sign-off
- [décision] No v6 provider in this PR, aws pinned to 5.82 (source: t04)
- [décision] pg_partman upgrade handled as separate step, no DB writes beyond read-only select (source: t10)
- [décision] No prod date until Maya signs off; apply_immediately stays false (source: t14)
